Greenland

2 directory entries · Research in progress

  • Inuit↗Circumpolar people / Greenland connection
    Connection & source
    Circumpolar people / Greenland connection

    ICC's own account explicitly identifies Inuit leaders from Kalaallit Nunaat (Greenland) alongside Alaska and Canada at its founding and describes subsequent Inuit participation. This directly supports Greenland for the broad Inuit access point without making a Canadian organization the government of Greenlandic communities. Inspection: Actual Our Story paragraphs on the 1977 founding, 1980 Nuuk assembly, charter ratification and circumpolar representation.

    Historical and continuing organizational/community relationship described by ICC. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Kalaallit↗People name / Greenland connection
    Connection & source
    People name / Greenland connection

    Section 5 discusses Kalaallit in the context of Greenlandic Inuit. This supports a Greenland connection for the existing access label, not the proposition that every Greenland resident is Kalaallit or that regional Inuit identities are interchangeable. Inspection: Actual section 5 identity/geography text and publisher ownership statement. Population percentages, current conditions and legal/political claims are not adopted. Limits: Popular tourism introduction, not an authoritative resolution of all regional self-designations. No current demographic figures or claim that all Greenlanders share one Indigenous identity.

    Identity/geography in undated tourism-board overview; no current statistics adopted. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
